review.en: Springsteen recorded these songs alone at home on a four-track cassette machine as demos; full-band versions were tried and set aside, and the tape itself was released. The stories follow killers, debtors and state troopers in small-town America. Its bare sound and its choice of the demo over the studio influenced later lo-fi and folk songwriters.
review.zh: 斯普林斯汀在家里用四轨卡带机独自录下这些歌，本是小样；乐队版试过之后被搁置，最后直接发行了这卷磁带。故事里有杀人犯、欠债的人和州警，背景是美国小镇。它赤裸的声音，以及选小样不选录音室的决定，影响了后来的低保真和民谣创作者。
